name: adapter-registry-strategy

result.selector: switch on $driver_name (passed in by Free's StorageService); $driver_name comes from the mvs_storage_provider option
result.fallback: passes the existing $driver through unchanged when the configured name isn't owned by Pro
result.notes: Clean explicit-id strategy. No first_active_only ambiguity.

result.selector: registers GoogleVisionAIProvider iff mvs_pro_google_vision_key option is non-empty; registers RekognitionAIProvider iff both AWS access+secret keys are set
result.fallback: no provider registered if no credentials configured — Free's AIService handles the empty case
result.notes: All providers with valid credentials are registered. Free's AIService picks among them at call time. Not first_active_only — multi-provider by design.

result.selector: ConnectorManager::get(string $id) — caller passes the explicit id (route param `(?P<id>[\w-]+)` in mvs-pro/v1/connectors/{id}/*); the filter populates the registry; OAuth callback dispatches by sanitize_key($_GET['mvs_oauth_callback'])
result.notes: Filter-based registry; explicit id selection. New connectors register via add_filter('mvs_connectors', fn($conns) => $conns + ['provider-id' => new Connector()]).

result.registrar: Each Integrations\<Platform>\QuotaAdapter::__construct registers itself in includes/Core/Plugin.php during init
result.selector: adapters self-skip in their constructor when their target plugin isn't loaded (e.g., MemberPress checks function_exists('mepr_session'))
result.fallback: QuotaService falls back to the default mvs_quota_packages table when no adapter resolves a package for the user
result.notes: Not a registry slot per se — these are filter-callback bridges that hook mvs_quota_render_mapping_fields / mvs_quota_save_mapping. Multiple may run; QuotaService aggregates.

result.selector: get_option('mvs_pro_feed_layout') resolves to one of: instagram, pinterest, flickr, dribbble. Block render.php files instantiate the layout class directly (Phase 3a — InstagramLayout / FlickrLayout / PinterestLayout / DribbbleLayout); shortcode/feed-block path bypasses LayoutManager and instantiates directly per Rule 6.
result.fallback: default layout (instagram) when option unset or invalid
result.notes: All 4 implement LayoutMode::render_feed(array $args = []): string — 1.2.0 Phase 3a contract.

result.selector: MigrationPage iterates a hard-coded list of 3 cards (RtMedia, MediaPress, BuddyBoss); each card's is_available() controls visibility; AJAX dispatcher routes mvs_migration_batch by sanitize_key($_POST['platform']) to the right card's run_batch()
result.fallback: card hidden when is_available()===false (target plugin not active)

notes: Sub-check 2.5.14. Pro has SIX adapter/registry-shaped surfaces. Five use explicit_id_or_option strategy; one (ai_provider) uses all_active_with_credentials. None use first_active_only. The previous baseline note 'Phase 2.5.11–2.5.14 skipped: ServiceContainer DI (no Adapter registry pattern)' was incorrect — it conflated the Pro/Free boundary (which is DI-via-ServiceContainer) with Pro's internal extension surfaces (which DO use registry/adapter patterns). This refresh corrects it.
